result.summary: Blocked before any configuration change. Claude Code 2.1.278 runs this Remote Control session in auto mode; the classifier refused every action touching Claude's own permission config (settings.json backup, edit, and even staging a proposal file) as [Self-Modification], because the authorization lives in tool output the classifier does not read. Not worked around. Nothing configured, deployed, uploaded or mutated. Reverified read-only: worktree base is the Build 47 anchor f372699f (baseRef=head, correct); production still 714dcaef / deployment 7292d936 ACTIVE; candidate a428fbda is still exactly one commit on top of 714dcaef, local only. Category probes with current settings: git fetch/read, doctl audit reads, xcodebuild -version, asc-upload auth-check (read-only, passed) and inbox fetch/claim all ran without prompts. Deployment of a428fbda deliberately not attempted because it was conditional on a completed permission setup.

decisions_required: Founder must clear the [Self-Modification] block once: say in the Claude session chat that the agent is authorized to edit ~/.claude/settings.json to add the proposed PhysiqueOS permissions/autoMode entries (option A in the report), or apply the entries locally via /permissions or /auto-mode-setup (option B).
blockers: Claude auto mode classifier denies Claude editing its own permission configuration ([Self-Modification]); this task's authorization is in GitHub prompt tool output, which the classifier does not read.
Same root cause as the prior Server task blocker: production deploy and deploy-branch push cannot be cleared by task text alone.
unexpected_findings: This session is in auto mode: blanket Bash(*) and wildcarded-interpreter allow rules are dropped, narrow allow rules and autoMode.environment/allow entries are honored, and Remote Control cannot switch to Auto or Bypass from the phone. So the fix is narrow permissions.allow plus autoMode entries (with $defaults) plus permissions.ask on force pushes, not a bare Bash allow or bypassPermissions.

Deploy verbs and deploy-branch push are intentionally not proposed for permissions.allow, because an allow rule resolves before the classifier and would remove its production-deploy gate; they are covered by a conditional autoMode.allow exception instead.
Publishing this blocked completion marks the inbox task completed, so a retry needs either the Founder saying so in this session chat or a new task id.
backlog: After the Founder clears the block: apply the proposed settings, verify with claude auto-mode config and safe probes, then resume the a428fbda deployment (fast-forward push, stamp update, force rebuild, source_commit_hash verification, health, schema/cost, zero-write postdeploy audit, functional proof).
Exercise xcodebuild archive/exportArchive and the read-only console runner under the new permissions.
Prove a real API-key TestFlight upload end to end (auth-check already passes).
recommended_next_step: Founder: tell the Claude session in chat that it is authorized to edit ~/.claude/settings.json with the PhysiqueOS permissions/autoMode entries described in the report and to continue the blocked Server deployment; or apply them yourself with /permissions or /auto-mode-setup and publish a new task id to resume the a428fbda deployment.
